name: DUAL CLOTRIMAZOLE (VAGINAL CREAM 10 GR/ 3 OVULES)
description: It is an effective 3-day treatment that helps relieve the bothersome symptoms of vaginal yeast infection from the first day of application: genital itching, burning, irritation, unpleasant odor, yellowish or white discharge, discomfort when urinating, and inflammation. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
